inlineSql: Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
SELECT UPI_TYPE From UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND UPI_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY UPI_TYPE
SELECT DISTINCT UPI_TYPE As UpiTypeL From UPI_DATA ORDER BY UPI_TYPE
SELECT UPI_ID,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO FROM UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND UPI_ID = ' ? '
SELECT * FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME AS PartyNameL,A.AC_CODE AS AcCodeL,A.VCH_NO AS VchNoT,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS OrderDtL,A.ADV_AMT AS AmountR,SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '-' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS AdjAmountR ,A.CO_YEAR AS YearL,A.CO_BOOK as BookL,A.HD_VCH_NO As HdVchNoL FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_ADJ AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ORD_LC AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ORD_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ORD_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ORD_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.ADV_AMT,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.HD_VCH_NO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN B.ORD_SIGN = '+' THEN B.ORD_AMT ELSE - B.ORD_AMT END) > 0 ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME
Select * From DM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND DM_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.DM_NAME As ItemNameL,A.DM_CODE as ItCodeL,B.GR_NAME As GroupL FROM DM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.DM_NAME
UPDATE APR_DETL SET APR_DETL.ISU_REC = 'N' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND SR_NO = ' ? '
UPDATE BAR_DETL SET BAR_DETL.APR_ISU = 'Y' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?

Select A.ORD_NO As OrdNoL,D.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,A.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,A.ITM_MRP as MrpR,A.VCH_SRNO,A.ORD_YRCD As OrdYrCdL,A.ORD_DBCD As OrdDbCdL,A.ORD_SRNO As OrdSrNoL,B.TAG_STK_LESS As TagStkLessM From ((BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ORD_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ORD_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ORD_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ORD_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.ORD_AC = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.ORD_NO <> '' AND B.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND A.ORD_AC = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? ORDER BY A.ORD_NO,A.TAG_NO
SELECT * FROM SL_ORD_DETL WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND OLD_SRNO = ' ? '

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM SL_ORD_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ?

SELECT A.AC_NAME AS AcNameL,A.VCH_DATE AS OrderDtL,A.VCH_NO AS OrderNoL, B.ITM_REMARK AS ItemNameL,B.DESIGN_NO AS DesignL,B.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,B.ITM_RATE AS RateR ,B.LBR_RATE AS LbrRateR,LBR_AMT As LbrAmtR FROM SL_ORD_DATA AS A INNER JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.CO_YEAR AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK AND A.VCH_NO = B.VCH_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ADV_AMT - A.ORD_ADJ_AMT > 0 OR B.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND A.AC_CODE IN ('00020',' ? ') ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE DESC

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_DATE DESC

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_DATE DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.TAG_NO <> 'N' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_DATE DESC

Select C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.TAG_NO <> 'N' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY SUBSTRING(C.DESIGN_NO,1,2), LEN(C.DESIGN_NO),C.DESIGN_NO,A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_DATE DESC

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME,B.GR_CODE FROM BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ' ? '

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE ? Y ? A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND ? A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ?
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? A ? AND IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND IT_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From TOUCH_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '
Select * From TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' and LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TABLE_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TABLE_NAME As CounterL,TABLE_CODE as CodeL FROM TABLE_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

Select A.IT_CODE,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) AS StkPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) AS StkGwt, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS StkNwt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT * FROM MSG_MAST WHERE MSG_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY MSG_TYPE
SELECT * FROM PRINT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PRINT_TYPE = ' ? ' AND BOOK_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PRINT_FILE
SELECT * FROM PRINT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = '01' AND PRINT_TYPE = ' ? ' AND BOOK_TYPE = ' ? ' ORDER BY PRINT_FILE
SELECT * FROM TAX_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAX_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT * FROM TAX_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAX_CODE = '13'
SELECT * FROM TAX_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAX_CODE = '11'
Select MAX(VCH_NO) As VchNo From SL_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' and CO_BOOK = ' ? ' HAVING MAX(VCH_NO) > 0
SELECT MAX(VCH_NO) AS VchNo From TEMP_BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' and CO_BOOK = ' ? ' HAVING MAX(VCH_NO) > 0
SELECT * FROM SL_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? '
SELECT AC_NAME FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE =' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT TAX_NAME FROM TAX_MAST WHERE CO_CODE =' ? ' AND SR_NO = 0 AND TAX_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT EMP_NAME FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE =' ? ' AND EMP_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT SUM(TOT_AMT) As TOT_AMT FROM PR_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND SL_BILL_YRCD = ' ? ' AND SL_BILL_DBCD = ' ? ' AND SL_BILL_NO = ' ? '

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM SL_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.SR_NO

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM SL_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.SR_NO,A.ISR_NO
SELECT A.* FROM SL_PR_DETL AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.SR_NO
Select * From SL_ORD_ADJ WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' Order By Sr_No
SELECT * FROM UPI_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY SR_NO
